resources.string: Cycles through the spectrum very slowly so it won\'t make you dizzy.
I don\'t have my model downloaded yet. Go to Settings › AI and tap “Download model” (one time, on Wi‑Fi).
To chat, first accept the AI terms.

The chat uses a small language model that you choose in Settings › AI (Gemma 4 E2B or Gemma 3 1B). It runs on your phone with Google\'s MediaPipe or LiteRT-LM. It is downloaded once (from Hugging Face or GitHub) and you can only have one downloaded at a time.
In local mode the model runs on your phone without internet: your messages never leave the device. Only the model download uses internet. MusicFlame does not receive your conversations.

It is a small model and can be wrong or make things up (years, BPM, albums, lyrics). Double-check important information. Don\'t use it for medical, legal, financial or safety decisions. Provided “as is”, without warranties.

It uses roughly 0.5 to 2.6 GB of storage depending on the model, and quite a bit of RAM while answering (more with the large models). It can take several seconds, warm up the phone and use battery. You can delete the model anytime in Settings › AI.

Gemma 4 is distributed under the Apache 2.0 license. Gemma 3 is provided under the Gemma Terms of Use (ai.google.dev/gemma/terms), which include its prohibited use policy. MediaPipe and LiteRT-LM are Apache 2.0. All allow use and redistribution with a license notice (see Settings › Third-party licenses). MusicFlame is an independent project: it is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.

Light option from Google (≈555 MB) for modest phones. Answers are simpler than Gemma 4. Downloaded from GitHub because the original repository requires signing in.

The recommended one: the smartest and, with MTP acceleration, fast on phones with a decent GPU. Large download (≈2.6 GB); 6 GB of RAM or more recommended. If you downloaded it before May 2026, delete it and download it again to enable the acceleration.
